description: This file defines the NoteRepository class responsible for CRUD operations on notes stored in a SQLite database within an Android app. It includes methods to retrieve, search, add, update, and delete notes, abstracting persistence details.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: Repository handling CRUD operations for notes using SQLite database.

methods.name: getAllNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes ordered by last update descending.

methods.name: searchNotes
methods.description: Searches notes by title or content using a LIKE query.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by its unique ID.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note by ID.

methods.name: cursorToNote
methods.description: Converts a database cursor position into a Note object.
